messages:
sasha: Heads up, ran a staged rollout of cfg-2026-21 and finance flagged a short spike in billed RPS for /v2/complete even though the rollout was preview.
liam: Preview should be shadow-only. Any metric snippets or router logs?
sasha: Router log extract:
```
router.apply cfg=cfg-2026-21 route=/v2/complete mode=preview
metrics.emit requests_total{route="/v2/complete",env="prod"} 73
```
Note theres no preview label on the emitted metric.
nora: Sounds like exporter is emitting before the preview label is attached or the router's apply ack path missed adding it. We saw a similar ordering race with cache flags.
tess: Billing PromQL is `sum(rate(requests_total[1m])) by (route)` so unlabeled preview traffic will be included in billable buckets.
infra-bot: config-bot: started apply cfg-2026-21 to prod-canary at 1809999987 :gear:
liam: Immediate mitigations I propose: (1) change quota queries to exclude preview explicitly: use `{preview!~"true|1"}` and (2) add a recording rule that synthesizes a `preview_effective="true"` label when `config_applied{mode="preview"}` exists for the same route+time window.
nora: Changing queries will affect dashboards and alerts; console "effective quota" and billing dashboards will diverge until we update UI. Need coordinated rollout.
tess: UX idea: console should surface a faint preview series and an orange banner on route detail whenever recent `config_applied{mode="preview"}` samples exist. That way product teams see preview traffic separated from billable.
liam: Also add an automated guard: if unlabeled_preview_rate / total_rate > 0.02 for >2m -> create a PagerDuty incident (P1-ish). We can relax after exporter fix.
sasha: I'll open infra/metrics PR to patch exporter so it tags metrics atomically with `preview=true` on apply ack. I'll also add the temporary PromQL change behind a metrics feature flag.
nora: We should also expose config provenance to the console: GET /config/effective?scope=route&route=/v2/complete -> return flattened value plus provenance list (applied_by, applied_at, mode, config_hash). That helps debugging when console and router disagree.
tess: Small UI change first: add help text on quota card that explains route-level overrides vs service defaults and when preview-excluded numbers are shown. Copy: "Displayed quota prefers router-applied config; preview/shadow traffic is excluded from these numbers."
infra-bot: monitoring-bot: suggested alert candidate created: |router_quota - console_quota|/console_quota > 0.2 for 5m -> page oncall.
liam: Implementation plan: 1) emergency PromQL change + recording rule (short-lived), 2) exporter fix (atomic label attach), 3) console API for provenance + UI tweaks, 4) enable metrics-feature-flag false->true over 2 weeks.
sasha: Timeline: opening PRs now. I'll include test plan: synthetic preview apply and assert `requests_total{preview="true"}` present immediately after apply and that billing queries exclude it.
nora: Add a small blameless postmortem note and capture the race pattern so we can add a linter/test in router code to prevent future unlabeled emits.
tess: I'll prototype the banner and preview series mock in product/console Figma and link it to the tickets.
sasha: Thanks all; tagging oncall and finance for visibility. :white_check_mark:
